lead: The coverage gate matches a member's *fully qualified* call spelling, so a case written through `use Core\Test;` covers nothing it calls.
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/conformance_coverage.rs` greps `--FILE--` sections for `Class::member(` with the whole class name, so `Test::assertTrue(` after a `use` answers for nothing and `cargo test` fails with "N registered `Core` member(s) are never used by a conformance case". Write each new member once in the `Core\…` spelling somewhere in the case.
